[package]
name = "maestro"
authors = ["Maximilian Luz <m@mxnluz.io>"]
version = "0.1.5"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT/Apache-2.0"
description = "Maestro protocol client implementation for controlling Google Pixel Buds Pro"
repository = "https://github.com/qzed/pbpctrl"

[dependencies]
arrayvec = "0.7.6"
bytes = "1.10.1"
futures = "0.3.31"
num_enum = "0.7.3"
prost = "0.14.1"
tracing = "0.1.41"
uuid = "1.16.0"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.44.2"
features = ["macros"]

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7.14"
features = ["codec"]

[build-dependencies]
prost-build = "0.14.1"

[dev-dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.98"
futures = "0.3.31"
pretty-hex = "0.4.1"
tracing-subscriber = "0.3.19"

[dev-dependencies.bluer]
version = "0.17.3"
features = ["bluetoothd", "rfcomm"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.44.2"
features = ["rt", "macros", "signal"]
